description: List websites, apps, agents, and skills: every one the organization has, with its kind, URL, access mode, and when it was last published. It is the first read when the user names something on Valet and you do not know what it is, and the way to recover a name an earlier publish has scrolled out of the conversation. Pass kind to narrow to one kind. Each row says its access mode. Valet's built-in skills are not listed until the organization makes its own; list_skills lists those. Requires connecting a Valet account.

kind.description: Narrow the list to one kind. Omit for everything.

org_name.description: The Valet organization to list. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: list_services

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

services.description: The services, sorted by name. Holds the first ones only when truncated is true.

access.description: Who can reach the service: public, private, or password.

active_release.description: Version of the live release. Absent for a service nobody has published.

last_published_at.description: RFC 3339 time the live release was created. Absent for a service nobody has published.

name.description: Name of the service. Pass it as name to the other service tools.

url.description: Address the service is served at. Absent when it has none, such as a service whose route is gone, and for an agent in an organization whose agent URLs are not turned on.

total.description: How many services matched, which is more than the length of services only when truncated is true.

truncated.description: True when the list was cut, so services holds only the first matches by name. Pass kind to narrow it.

title: List websites, apps, agents, and skills
